name: Yuras
source:
Strong like the storm, cold like the snow - an honest, straightforward boy with few words, Yuras doesn't initiate conversations unless you prompt him to.

Yuras' strength will be your best asset. Don't expect much about everything else though. He can be found in the Ice Age.

[from [url=http://www.zeiva.net/otome/area_x_cast_livan.html]official site[/url]]
